post.description: scope ALL resuelve todos los episodios; RANGE, los episodios con número entre from y to (ambos obligatorios, from ≤ to); EPISODES, exactamente los números de episodeNumbers (los que el anime no tiene se omiten y se devuelven en missingEpisodeNumbers). Responde 400 si ningún episodio coincide.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Clave única por intento del usuario (p. ej. un UUID v4), repetida en cada reintento de esa misma solicitud. Si la clave ya creó un trabajo de este anime con el mismo cuerpo y el trabajo no ha expirado, se devuelve ese trabajo con un accessToken nuevo en lugar de crear otro; los tokens anteriores siguen valiendo. Con otro cuerpo responde 422; tras 10 repeticiones, 409.

info.title: AnimeHub API
info.description: Contrato público REST compartido por AnimeHub Web y Desktop.

jobCapability.description: Capacidad opaca y temporal devuelta al crear un trabajo de descarga; no es un JWT.

kind.description: Source relation label: PREQUEL Precuela, SEQUEL Secuela, MAIN_STORY Historia principal, FULL_STORY Historia completa, SIDE_STORY Historia paralela, SPIN_OFF Spin-off, SUMMARY Resumen, ALTERNATIVE Versión alternativa, ALTERNATIVE_SETTING Ambientación alternativa, OTHER Otro (the source itself gives no specific relation).

firstNumber.description: Lowest episode number across ALL episodes of the anime (not only this page); null when it has none. Movies are often a single episode 0.

lastNumber.description: Highest episode number across ALL episodes of the anime (not only this page); null when it has none.

totalPages.description: Pages reported by the source; never more than 50.

totalRecords.description: Records reported by the source; clamped at 1000 (see capped).

capped.description: true when the source truncated the result set at its maximum of 1000 records / 50 pages: more titles match than totalRecords and pages beyond 50 are empty, so narrow the query (e.g. letter, year or genre filters) to reach them. totalRecords is then a lower bound ("1000+").

basisPublishedAt.description: Equals latestEpisode.publishedAt. Its weekday and time in the viewer's time zone define the weekly slot; the next episode is expected 7 days later. Entries whose basisPublishedAt is more than 21 days old (hiatus or irregular releases) are omitted.

isFinalEpisode.description: latestEpisode completes a finished series: there is no next episode. Such entries are kept for 48 hours after basisPublishedAt.

ScheduleEntryDto.description: One weekly slot. latestEpisode is the newest episode of the series already published at the source (never a future one); the next expected episode is latestEpisode.number + 1, due 7 days after basisPublishedAt, unless isFinalEpisode.

scope.description: Every existing episode whose number is within [from, to] (inclusive).

episodeNumbers.description: Episode numbers to resolve (finite, >= 0, decimals allowed, no duplicates). Numbers the anime does not have are skipped and listed in the receipt as missingEpisodeNumbers; if none exists the request fails with 400.

missingEpisodeNumbers.description: EPISODES scope only: requested numbers the anime does not have, which the job skips (ascending). Always empty for ALL and RANGE.

updatedAt.description: Last known change of the anime page content: the newer of its last detected detail change (title, synopsis, episode list, relations) and its latest episode publication.
